notes: `runJavaInstaller` (line 258-260's MARK comment says explicitly: 'Used by both NeoForgeInstaller and ForgeInstaller, which share the same installer invocation pattern') is one private free function both installers call -- there is no per-family invocation code to characterize separately. When javaPath contains '/', it's used directly as executableURL (after `~` expansion) and the arguments are just `-jar <jar> --installServer`; cwd is always the server directory being installed into, never a temp dir.
